finalText: Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `resolveConfig` referenced an undefined bare variable `retries` (a `ReferenceError`) instead of `env.retries`, which crashed the link stage. The three `WARN` lines in the log (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) were just noise unrelated to the failure — worth cleaning up eventually, but not build-breaking.
